image_description: A close-up shot of a white ceramic bowl containing scoops of ice cream. The primary scoop is a pale yellow/cream color with a textured surface, accompanied by a dark brown (chocolate) wafer or cookie piece inserted into it. To the left, there is another scoop that appears slightly melted or softer, blending into the background. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), suggesting a shallow depth of field.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The insertion point of the dark wafer into the ice cream lacks clear displacement or shadowing. It looks slightly pasted on rather than physically embedded, though this is subtle.
